frames.label: ESTR sells off through the belly
frames.note: Four basis points at five years, tapering into the wings. ESTR is the discount curve for EURIBOR and one of the two inputs to the cross currency curve, so this carries

frames.label: SONIA steepens
frames.note: The long end drifts up three basis points and the front is left where it was. Nothing is built on SONIA, so the work stops there

frames.label: The SONIA messages arrive again
frames.note: A feed reconnect replaying a window it has already sent. Rejected on sequence number, nothing rebuilds

frames.label: SOFR shifts up two basis points
frames.note: Twelve quotes on one curve inside one cycle, coalesced into a single rebuild rather than twelve

frames.label: The meeting dated curve reprices the front end
frames.note: Three basis points around the one year point, with one quote corrected again before the cycle runs

frames.label: ESTR gaps again
frames.note: The solve fails on this one. The last good curve keeps being served and is marked stale, rather than the screen going blank

frames.label: ESTR retraces
frames.note: The next attempt succeeds, the pending quotes are finally priced in and the stale mark clears

frames.label: The EURIBOR basis widens a basis point and a half
frames.note: EURIBOR is a projection curve and nothing is built on it, so this moves the book without moving another curve
